## Gameplay Rules:

- All runs need to be performed on the **official version** of the game [(linked here)](https://www.roblox.com/games/6516141723/FLOOR-2-DOORS).
- Revives are **not** allowed.
- You **may** increase your maximum FPS in settings as there are no noticeable advantages.
- SUPER HARD MODE!!! and RETRO MODE are not allowed. Legacy (Hotel-) runs can be submitted.
- Glitches that may be **game-breaking** (e.g. skipping a consecutive amount of rooms with little to no movement/ skipping whole boss fights in seconds) are **not** allowed.
- No use of third-party applications to give an advantage (macros, shaders, exploits, etc.) with the exception of gamma.
- You are allowed to rebind a key to a different bind, however you are not allowed to rebind any key to the scroll wheel.
- Performance Stats are allowed except for Shift + F2 (in-game) since it allows you to see the correct door through walls.
- The use of Alt + 1, or the Roblox Screenshot Capture System as an advantage to see past certain UI on screen (such as "The Mines" text/logo) is not allowed in runs.

## Recording Rules:

- **All co-op runs** must have all POVs of players included in the speedrun description, or the video link area. 
- Video must be raw/unedited (unless editing a timer/subtitles in).
- Timers are optional and not required.
- Knob counter/revives must be visible in the top right corner for the **entire** duration of gameplay (load-times excluded)
- For solo runs, doorknobs and revives must be visible in the top right corner with nothing blocking it. **Top 5 co-op runs require doorknobs to be visible across all POVs**.
- **Audio is required to be audible across every run, as well as having some sort of viewable quality (preferably above 25fps)**.
- **(XBOX Players only)** For longer runs, you are allowed to break up the recording into 2 or more videos due to only being able to record up to 10 minutes at a time. For these cases, you must restart the recording as soon as possible, and you may ***not*** cut out major parts of the run.

categories.name: (Old) All Floors
categories.rules:
# General Rules

- You must start from backdoors then proceed to the hotel, then the rooms and then the mines.
- You must go through all 1000 doors in The Rooms.
- You are not allowed to use rifted items.
- No glitches are allowed, however, minor glitches that have small time saves or don’t effect the game as much are allowed.
- Max time limit for runs is 4 hours.

# Timing Rules

- Runs will be retimed removing loads and following retiming rules from all floors:

1. **The Backdoor**: Starts the frame the game starts to become visible when the “Loading” screen starts fading away, and ends the frame the overview UI pops up after exiting.
2. **The Hotel**: Starts the frame the door starts breaking (where light cracks can be seen through the door), and ends the frame the overview UI pops up after entering The Rooms.
3. **The Rooms**: Starts the frame the door starts breaking (where light cracks can be seen through the door), and ends the frame the overview UI pops up after exiting The Rooms.
4. **The Hotel (Continued)**: Starts the frame the door starts breaking (where light cracks can be seen though the door), and ends the frame where one of the following things happen:

- Lighting Change (noticeable on high graphics, the boxes change color and the gate has a shadow), usually happens first
- Elevator Gate appearing - **Noticable on the ground of the elevator as well** (when the shadows of the gate are visible)
- Character Teleporting
- Items/Healthbar disappearing
- Camera Panning

5. **The Mines**: Time starts as soon as **"The Mines"** text appears, and ends the frame the screen turns black **without the interactive interface** (holding E on the castle door) **disappearing**/items disappear from the inventory.

- After all these times are found, they are then added together to give you the final time of the run.

games.rules:
*(Also refer to Category Rules)*

## Gameplay Rules:

- All runs need to be performed on the **official version** of the game [(linked here)](https://www.roblox.com/games/6516141723/FLOOR-2-DOORS).
- Revives are **not** allowed.
- You **may** increase your maximum FPS in settings as there are no noticeable advantages.
- SUPER HARD MODE!!! and RETRO MODE are not allowed. Legacy (Hotel-) runs can be submitted.
- Glitches that may be **game-breaking** (e.g. skipping a consecutive amount of rooms with little to no movement/ skipping whole boss fights in seconds) are **not** allowed.
- No use of third-party applications to give an advantage (macros, shaders, exploits, etc.) with the exception of gamma.
- You are allowed to rebind a key to a different bind, however you are not allowed to rebind any key to the scroll wheel.
- Performance Stats are allowed except for Shift + F2 (in-game) since it allows you to see the correct door through walls.
- The use of Alt + 1, or the Roblox Screenshot Capture System as an advantage to see past certain UI on screen (such as "The Mines" text/logo) is not allowed in runs.

## Recording Rules:

- **All co-op runs** must have all POVs of players included in the speedrun description, or the video link area. 
- Video must be raw/unedited (unless editing a timer/subtitles in).
- Timers are optional and not required.
- Knob counter/revives must be visible in the top right corner for the **entire** duration of gameplay (load-times excluded)
- For solo runs, doorknobs and revives must be visible in the top right corner with nothing blocking it. **Top 5 co-op runs require doorknobs to be visible across all POVs**.
- **Audio is required to be audible across every run, as well as having some sort of viewable quality (preferably above 25fps)**.
- **(XBOX Players only)** For longer runs, you are allowed to break up the recording into 2 or more videos due to only being able to record up to 10 minutes at a time. For these cases, you must restart the recording as soon as possible, and you may ***not*** cut out major parts of the run.

values.name: Co-op
values.rules:
### Beat The Mines with the highest modifier percentage you can, with any modifiers you’d like.

- The percentage must be **175% or higher**.
- Put the percentage you got as milliseconds in the time. 
- You must show the **in-game list** of active modifiers somewhere in the run.
- Random modifiers (Uh Oh, How Unfortunate, Chaos x2) are all allowed.
- The pre-run shop is allowed and optional.
- Runs may be Solo or Co-op (which both go under separate leaderboards.)

# RTA Retiming

- The time of the run will not affect the rank of the run.
- The *Time* annotation is the real time of the run, in the HH:MM:SS.MMM format.

- Time starts as soon as the avatar icon(s) on the elevator door disappears (just look at the elevator door at all times)
- Time ends the frame the ending cutscene begins (when one of the the following things happen):

1. Lighting Change (noticeable on high graphics, the boxes change color and the gate has a shadow), usually happens first
2. Elevator Gate appearing - Noticeable on the ground of the elevator as well (when the shadows of the gate are visible)
3. Character Teleporting
4. Items/Healthbar disappearing
5. Camera Panning

values.name: Alarm Clock
values.rules:
### Obtain an Alarm Clock as fast as possible.

- Runs must be done solo.
- Pre-shop is optional.
- You are **NOT** allowed to carry over items from previous floors.
- Runs must use a **random seed**.

## Retiming:

- Time starts as soon as **''The Mines''** text appears.
- Time ends the frame the item appears in your hotbar.

values.name: Door 51-Elevator
values.rules:
### Complete the last 50 doors as fast as possible.

- Runs *can* be co-op.
- The pre-shop or using items in the run are optional.
- You may not use rifted/Backdoor items.
- Runs must use a **random seed**.
- Max time limit for runs is 20 minutes.

## Retiming:

- Time starts the frame the lock starts moving after pressing the green button when completing The Library.
- Time ends the frame the ending cutscene begins (when one of the the following things happen):

1. Lighting Change (noticeable on high graphics, the boxes change color and the gate has a shadow), usually happens first
2. Elevator Gate appearing - **Noticeable on the ground of the elevator as well** (when the shadows of the gate are visible)
3. Character Teleporting
4. Items/Healthbar disappearing
5. Camera Panning

values.name: Door 151-Castle
values.rules:
### Complete the last 50 doors as fast as possible.

- Runs can be co-op.
- Pre-shop is optional.
- You are **NOT** allowed to carry over items from previous floors.
- Runs must use a **random seed**.
- Max time limit for runs is 20 minutes.

## Retiming:

- Time ends the frame the escape cutscene starts from The Nest.
- Time ends the frame the interaction bar on the castle door resets after being fully filled up (no more game inputs are required at this point).
